body.name: Complete generic factor-line branch family \(\mathfrak B_p(G,G')\)
body.construction: For a same-transitive-closure pair of DAGs \(G,G'\) on \(V\) in their common topological order and \(\theta\in\mathcal M^{\circ}_{\mathrm{branch},p,q}(G,G')\), fix one common-permutation representative, factor each \(D_k\) as \(D_k=\ell_km_k^{\mathsf T}+m_k\ell_k^{\mathsf T}\), choose one of its two real factor lines for each nonroot and its unique line for each root, and put every chosen line in the rational projective gauge whose least-index nonzero observed coordinate is \(1\). For that choice impose \(L\operatorname{diag}(v')L^{\mathsf T}=\Sigma^{(0)}\), \(Lz_k+\rho_k\ell_k=m_k\), \(z_k\) supported on \(\operatorname{an}_{G'}(k)\), \(t'_k=v'_k+2\rho_k-\sum_i z_{ki}^2/v'_i>0\), \(\delta_k'{}^{\mathsf T}=z_k^{\mathsf T}\operatorname{diag}(v')^{-1}U\), and every exact-support, retained-edge, and mixing-column inequation; \(\mathfrak B_p(G,G')\) is the resulting family of at most \(2^{q-r}\) systems for that representative. Candidate variance-neutral branches remain legal.
